bootstrap.estimand: candidate pooled micro rate minus comparator pooled micro rate, recomputed inside each draw
bootstrap.zero_denominator_policy: rate is null; an interval is null if the observed contrast is undefined; otherwise any undefined resample is excluded and counted

definitions.alignment_matched_characters: C = N_ref - S - D = N_hyp - S - I, using the reported unit-cost Levenshtein opcode counts
definitions.alignment_matched_hypothesis_rate: AMHR = C / N_hyp; undefined when N_hyp = 0
definitions.alignment_matched_reference_rate: AMRR = C / N_ref; undefined when N_ref = 0
definitions.cpcer_assignment_scope: one minimum-error stream permutation per recording and system
definitions.fixed_comparator_assignment_view: for each paired contrast, rescore candidate stream texts with the comparator's reported assignment; score unused candidate streams against empty references
definitions.hypothesis_characters: N_hyp = C + S + I = N_ref - D + I
definitions.interpretation_limit: AMRR and AMHR are alignment-derived diagnostics, not semantic recall, semantic precision, useful-speech coverage, or proof that a matched occurrence is acoustically supported
definitions.own_assignment_view: derive C and N_hyp from each system's own reported minimum-cpCER recording-level assignment
